task: Draft an acceptance-criteria clause for a fictional software-development agreement using the supplied facts. Do not add testing periods, payment-release triggers, or automatic acceptance rules not in the facts.

facts.text: The fictional agreement is between Orvant Software Ltd. and Crestfield Bank.
Deliverables are deemed accepted when Crestfield confirms in writing that the deliverable meets the specifications in Annex B.
If Crestfield identifies a defect, Orvant has the opportunity to remedy it.
The facts do not specify a remedy period.

forbidden_additions: A specific remedy period not in the facts.
An automatic acceptance rule triggered by the passage of time.
A payment milestone tied to acceptance.
preserve: The reference to Annex B specifications.
The opportunity to remedy a defect without specifying a period.
